name: Grid Traversal Setup (DDA)
aliases: DDA Ray Casting for Voxel Grids
definition: Initializes parameters for a 3D Digital Differential Analyzer (DDA) to traverse a voxel grid along a ray, computing step directions, initial indices, and distances to voxel boundaries.
summary: Grid Traversal Setup (DDA) initializes ray-voxel traversal by computing exact boundary distances and step directions, distinguishing itself by operating directly in grid coordinates.
